summary.rrsp_note: RRSP uninvested value is shown separately because withdrawals are taxable and restricted by the retirement plan.

setup.title: Set up ForeView
setup.heading: Set up the model
setup.lede: Enter the people, accounts, current balances, and fixed-term deposits used by financial records and projections.
setup.annual_rate_help: Enter the rate as a percentage.

assets.title: Assets
assets.lede: Accounts grouped by the financial rules that apply to them.
assets.snapshot_help: These values are saved as a dated balance snapshot. Leave balance blank when only editing account details.
assets.subaccount_reference_placeholder: Only if the institution provides one

income.title: Income
income.heading: Income and tax records
income.lede: Factual annual income, deductions, taxes, and contribution limits retained by person and tax year.
income.future_help: Projection rules for rental, pension, business, dividend, capital-gain, and other factual income can be added independently while their tax-document values remain available here.
income.rrsp_note: Cash deposited during the year, not contribution room
income.when_correct: When to correct a factual value
income.corrected_help: This overrides the application value. It does not change the official document.
income.reason_help: Explain why the application should use a different factual value.
income.pdf_help: The document type is detected automatically. The PDF is analysed for preview and is not stored. Verify the taxpayer before saving.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.heading: Expenses
expenses.lede: High-level factual household spending retained separately from projection assumptions.
expenses.no_data: No factual expense information has been recorded for this year. Spending is unknown, not $0.
expenses.resolve_overlap: resolve all potential overlaps before this year has a factual total.
expenses.no_records: No expense records for this year.
expenses.imported_note: Imported expense statements will appear here when a supported source module supplies parsed evidence for confirmation.
expenses.create_active: Create an active category before adding an expense.
expenses.no_categories: No expense categories have been created.
expenses.set_up_category: Set up an expense category first.
expenses.category_help: Categories group related spending in your summaries and identify it as required or discretionary. For this bill, you could create a required category named Utilities.
expenses.recorded_note: Recorded totals include only evidence for periods that overlap {year}.
expenses.seasonal_note: The seasonal estimate keeps current actuals and applies {rate}% inflation to the preceding year's corresponding uncovered periods when a complete comparison is available.
expenses.incomplete_note: They do not imply that every expense has been recorded.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lede: Link financial institutions and synchronize their data into the local model.
connections.sync_help: Synchronize balances, positions, and recent executions from connected institutions.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.lede: Review activity within the account category whose financial rules apply.
transactions.bank_balance_help: Some bank exports, including RBC CSV, do not include balances. Enter a known latest balance in Assets to reconstruct the running balances for those transactions.
transactions.cash_flow_help: Once transactions are imported, this view will compare the last 12 months with the preceding period.
transactions.reconcile_help: Enter a balance you know to be correct. Calculated running balances will be rebuilt from this anchor. Balances supplied directly by bank files are preserved.

tax_rules.title: Tax rules
tax_rules.heading: Tax rules
tax_rules.lede: Review and approve the public tax and payroll rules used by projections.
tax_rules.review_help: Review government rules stored with the application and approve their exact content hash for this runtime.
tax_rules.effective_help: Ordinary taxable income using the basic personal amount. Includes the federal BPA phaseout and applicable jurisdiction rules such as the Quebec abatement, Manitoba BPA phaseout, and Ontario surtaxes. Excludes the Ontario Health Premium and income-specific treatment for capital gains and dividends.
tax_rules.none: No version-controlled public-rule packages were found.

salary.title: Salary projection
salary.heading: Employment and disposable income
salary.lede: Project salary, payroll contributions, income tax, RRSP contributions and disposable employment income.
salary.disclaimer: Projections are estimates for planning purposes only, are not financial, tax, investment, accounting, or legal advice, and important results should be independently verified.
salary.payroll_help: CPP or QPP contributions recorded on the tax return
salary.spending_help: Enter annual after-tax spending. Required spending covers costs such as utilities, taxes and tuition. Discretionary spending is a flexible fund for items such as hobbies, tools and travel. Planned one-time events and contingency reserves will be added separately.
salary.save_as_help: The selected scenario and all people are copied. Any changes currently visible are applied to the copy.
salary.method_note: Each annual salary is the previous row's salary with that year's raise applied, unless manually overridden. Other employment income is then added to the salary earned during the year to produce total employment income. Future years use the latest approved official rules held constant until a newer rule year is available. Retirement date is the first non-working day. RRSP cash contribution and tax deduction are separate values. Use × beside a saved override to reset that cell to its calculated value, then click Save.
salary.saved_status: Changes are saved to the selected scenario. Use Save As to compare alternatives.
salary.dirty_status: Unsaved changes. Save to update this scenario.

about.title: About ForeView
about.heading: About ForeView
about.lede: Understand, manage, and model your financial life. See where you are. Explore what's ahead.
about.description: ForeView is a local-first personal and household financial management, analysis, and modelling application.
about.version_note: Module versions use calendar versioning: YYYY.MM.DD, with an optional numeric revision for multiple changes on the same day.

disclaimer.lede: Important limitations on financial calculations and projections.
